messages:
Sam (Support): Quick escalation — customer NimbusHealth reporting intermittent tool/function call failures after migrating to our hosted runtime v2.8.0 + new SDKs. Error: \"schema validation failed: payload expected object but was string\". High priority, customer impact on production paths.
Alex (Customer Success): They see ~6-10% failures on translate/annotate routes. Said it started ~2024-04-25 14:20 UTC after switching to our function-calling client helpers. Provided repro samples in TS, Python, and Go.
Sam (Support): Pasting the TS repro they sent (minimal):
```ts
// client.ts (user)
await client.callTool('annotate', { image: { url: 'https://x.jpg' }, metadata: { labels: ['a','b'] } });
```
They sometimes get a 400 from tool-forwarder with body error: `{"error":"schema validation failed","details":"field 'args' expected object, got string"}`.
Marta (Observability): I pulled the raw requests from ingress logs for one failed trace id `trace-9f3b`: request body to /v1/tools/call was:
```json
{"tool":"annotate","args":"{\"image\":{\"url\":\"https://x.jpg\"},\"metadata\":{\"labels\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}}"}
```
So `args` is a JSON string.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Confirmed in runtime: our validation layer expects `args` to be an object. We do have a compatibility layer that attempts to parse string fields once, but double-encoded payloads (string of an encoded string) slip through because of extra escaping. Example seen in logs: \"\\\"{\\\\\"image\\\\\":...}\\\"\" -> ends up as string after one parse.
Priya (DevEx): I dug into sdk-client code. Pattern found across SDKs: the helper `buildToolCall` is pre-serializing the args to support streaming (we added that in v0.40+). Sample TS bug (current published):
```ts
// sdk/lib/toolCall.ts
export function buildToolCall(tool, args) {
  return { tool, args: JSON.stringify(args) };
}
// later: fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) })
```
This double-encodes. Fix is to not stringify args at this layer and let top-level JSON.stringify handle it.
Priya (DevEx): Python has the same anti-pattern: user-level code sets `payload['args'] = json.dumps(args)` and then uses `requests.post(url, json=payload)` which will json-encode again. Go does identical: `body.Args = string(jsonBytes)` then `json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)`.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Two immediate approaches: 1) emergency unwrap in gateway/runtime to try to detect stringified objects and JSON.parse them (best-effort); 2) ship SDK patches to stop pre-stringifying. 1 is faster but brittle; 2 is correct but needs releases across three SDKs.
Sam (Support): Customer accepted a temporary mitigation if we can get it out today — they want minimal downtime. Also flagged possible billing noise due to retries.
Marta (Observability): I'll add a temporary metric and alert: increment when we see validation error containing \"expected object, got string\" and tag by sdk-user-agent. That will help see which clients remain broken after patches.
Priya (DevEx): Proposed immediate action plan:
- Hotfix (hosted only): gateway middleware unwraps when it sees a top-level stringified `args` field. Add header `x-rw-unstringify: true` in outgoing proxy to runtime while we patch SDKs. Will ship as canary to 5% first. (PR in progress).
- SDK fixes (48h): cut patches ts@0.41.2, py@0.41.2, go@0.41.2 to remove JSON.stringify/json.dumps in buildToolCall and add tests to assert typeof args === 'object' in the built payload.
- Tests & CI (longer): integration tests that call through gateway+runtime with nested payloads, edge-case escaping, streaming vs non-streaming paths.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): I'll submit a tiny runtime change to safely attempt a second JSON.parse if the first parse returns a string. It will only run when a header `x-rw-unstringify` is present. This buys time. I'll open the runtime PR and gateway PR and link here.
Priya (DevEx): I'll prepare SDK PRs now. Quick unit tests I will add to ensure we never stringify at that layer. Also a lint rule to detect direct `JSON.stringify` of args passed to `buildToolCall`.
Alex (Customer Success): I'll tell the customer: hotfix to be canaried in next 6-12h, full SDK patches in ~48h, workaround: if they control callers they can parse the string before passing to tool call (ugly) or pin to previous runtime (not ideal). Ask billing to investigate overages.
billing-bot: Opened billing ticket #BILL-3399 for NimbusHealth potential overage; assigned to billing-team.
Sam (Support): Please include reproducer snippets in the runbook. Here are consolidated repro steps from customer:
1) Use SDK helper buildToolCall/callTool to call annotated tool with nested args.
2) Observe 400s intermittently.
3) Confirm request body has `args` as a string.
They included a minimal Go repro: 
```go
// user.go (repro)
args := map[string]any{"image": map[string]any{"url": "https://x.jpg"}}
argsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(args)
body := map[string]any{"tool": "annotate", "args": string(argsBytes)}
json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
```
That mirrors our SDK bug pattern.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Deploy plan for hotfix: merge PR -> staging canary by 1715012345 -> smoke tests -> prod canary 5% -> monitor for 1h -> ramp if OK. Will annotate runtime/gateway with `x-rw-unstringify` header feature flag enabled for canary.
deploy-bot: Hotfix branch deployed to staging at 1715010456 for internal testing.
Marta (Observability): Dashboard link: https://obs.redwood.internal/d/tool-calls/validation-errors (temporary). I've added user-agent breakdown and traces count.
Priya (DevEx): SDK patches drafted: TS PR #278, Py PR #181, Go PR #92. I'll request expedited review. Changelogs will note: \"Fix: avoid double-encoding tool args in function-call helpers; ensure args are sent as objects.\"
Sam (Support): Thanks. I'll update NimbusHealth with timelines and the temporary workaround (parse string on their side) and offer credit if billing spike confirmed. Keeping thread open for deploy updates and final verification.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): After staging smoke I saw no regressions; runtime unwrap heuristic sounds safe for the short term. I'll post PR links once merged.
Priya (DevEx): Once SDK patches are released we'll send a broadcast to customers using function-calling helpers to update. Also creating a migration note in docs explaining not to pre-serialize args.
Sam (Support): Closing interim loop: mitigation in place, SDK fixes ETA ~48h, monitoring in place, billing escalated. Will follow up with NimbusHealth ASAP. :white_check_mark:
